meta.title: Madison County — the money trail
meta.note: Madison County’s total 2025 appropriation, $18,281,798.16, stated in the enacting clause of Appropriation Ordinance 2024-20 (“there is hereby appropriated… the sum of $18,281,798.16”), read from the county’s own ordinance. The department-by-department detail is in the attached budget on file with the County Clerk — adding it is on the docket.
